description: This file defines the core runtime index for a plugin system, including lazy loading of modules, runtime creation functions for TTS, media understanding, image/video generation, model authentication, and gateway subagent management. It exports a function to create a comprehensive plugin runtime object with various capabilities.

methods.name: createRuntimeTts
methods.description: Creates a runtime object for Text-to-Speech capabilities, binding lazy-loaded TTS methods.

methods.name: createRuntimeMediaUnderstandingFacade
methods.description: Creates a facade for media understanding functions, binding lazy-loaded media understanding methods.

methods.name: loadRuntimeImageGenerationModule
methods.description: Loads and caches the image generation runtime module.

methods.name: createRuntimeImageGeneration
methods.description: Creates an image generation runtime with generate and listProviders methods.

methods.name: loadRuntimeVideoGenerationModule
methods.description: Loads and caches the video generation runtime module.

methods.name: createRuntimeVideoGeneration
methods.description: Creates a video generation runtime with generate and listProviders methods.

methods.name: createRuntimeModelAuth
methods.description: Creates a runtime object for model authentication, with methods to get API keys and resolve providers.

methods.name: createUnavailableSubagentRuntime
methods.description: Creates a runtime subagent that throws errors if used, indicating unavailability.

methods.name: setGatewaySubagentRuntime
methods.description: Sets the global gateway subagent runtime for dynamic resolution.

methods.name: clearGatewaySubagentRuntime
methods.description: Clears the global gateway subagent runtime, used in tests.

methods.name: createLateBindingSubagent
methods.description: Creates a subagent that resolves to an explicit one, the global gateway subagent, or throws if unavailable.

methods.name: createPluginRuntime
methods.description: Creates the main plugin runtime object with various capabilities, including optional media, TTS, and generation modules.
